explication: FOSSology is a license-compliance platform and command-line toolkit. Its principal workflow takes a software upload through scheduled analysis, stores scan results for review, and generates compliance reports. Major branches include copyright and export-control scanning, package metadata extraction, duplicate-file-aware scanning, and report import. The README documents the overall workflow and capabilities; sampled source confirms API-to-DAO access and database wrappers, but does not expose every subsystem’s runtime wiring.
